description: This file contains utility functions and classes for tracing and debugging distributed communication in PyTorch, including trace key generation, trace analysis, and serialization helpers.

methods.name: getTraceStartKey
methods.description: Generates a key for starting trace in the store based on process group name and rank.

methods.name: getTraceEndKey
methods.description: Generates a key for ending trace in the store based on process group name and rank.

methods.name: traceUpdate
methods.description: Updates the store with trace information for a given key, sequence number, and column.

methods.name: ranksToString
methods.description: Converts a vector of ranks to a comma-separated string.

methods.name: ranksFromTrace
methods.description: Converts trace items into a comma-separated string of ranks.

methods.name: analyzeMissingRanks
methods.description: Generates a report string for ranks that are missing from the trace.

methods.name: analyzeLaggingRanks
methods.description: Analyzes trace map to identify lagging or mismatched ranks and generates a report.

methods.name: dumpSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot report of the latest states of ranks in the trace map.

methods.name: parseTraceValue
methods.description: Parses trace value from store to extract sequence number and column name.

methods.name: retrieveDesyncReport
methods.description: Generates a desynchronization report based on trace data from the store.

methods.name: pickle_str
methods.description: Serializes a C++ IValue into a string using PyTorch's pickler.

methods.name: get_python_cpp_trace
methods.description: Collects and formats a combined Python and C++ stack trace.

methods.name: new_dict
methods.description: Creates a new empty dictionary of IValues.

methods.name: new_list
methods.description: Creates a new empty list of IValues.

methods.name: ranks_str
methods.description: Formats a vector of uint64 ranks into a string.
